lines_of_business: All lines of business unless noted in Program Exceptions
criteria_location: Position Statement, pp.~5-9 of 16, one titled block per procedure. K-L and Outerbridge grade tables sit right after the last block (footnotes ** and ***), not beside the criteria that use them. Definitions section says 'No guideline specific definitions apply'. About 10 pages are evidence summary and references.

logic.top_level: pathways (one block per procedure; several have inner any-of pathways)

k_of_n.quote: Failure of at least 3 months of conservative non-operative management that includes at least 2 of the following: Medications (unless contraindicated); assistive device(s); home exercise; physical therapy, therapeutic injections into the joint; activity modification

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Inline negatives inside the all-of lists ('No imaging evidence of meniscus tear, loose body, advanced arthritis (Kellgren grade III or IV), or fracture'; 'No patellar dislocation'). No separate contraindication section, no global exclusions.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: None. No repeat-procedure, second-side or revision rules. Only 'inadequate response to a prior surgical procedure' as a prerequisite for osteochondral autografting.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Meniscectomy and/or meniscal repair meets the definition of medical necessity for any of the following: ... Acute injury ... when the following are met: o MRI evidence of a frank lateral or medial meniscus-bucket handle tear, AND o Failure of at least 6 weeks
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Top bullets are any-of, inner o bullets are all-of, but only the first lead-in says 'when the following are met'; the second bullet's inner list uses AND while the third bullet has no conservative-therapy requirement at all.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Synovectomy meets the definition of medical necessity for the following: Bleeding into the joint ... Painful plica, and the following ... Presence of proliferative synovial disease ...
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: No ALL/ANY word at the top; reader must infer the bullets are alternatives and the 'and the following' sub-bullets are conjunctive. One sub-bullet ends with 'AND' only on some items.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Patellar realignment ... Recurrent patellar dislocation or subluxation, and the following: ... Failure of 6 months ... OR  o Patellofemoral tenderness and abnormal articulation ...
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Stray OR at the end of a nested list closes one branch; where the any-of scope ends is a layout inference.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Osteochondral autografting ... Candidate is a skeletally mature adolescent with documented closure of growth plates (e.g., ≥15 years), OR an adult considered too young ... (e.g., ≤55 years), AND
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: OR nested inside one AND bullet; 'e.g.' makes the age cutoffs examples, not thresholds.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Diagnostic ... Xray and MRI results are inconclusive, AND No imaging evidence of meniscus tear, loose body, advanced arthritis ...
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Second bullet repeats and narrows the first; whether 'inconclusive' can coexist with a documented finding is unclear.

requirement_kinds.quote: Failure of at least 3 months of conservative non-operative management that includes at least 2 of the following
requirement_kinds.where: Position Statement: diagnostic, debridement OA/cartilage/PF, ACL(persistent), PCL, plica synovectomy

requirement_kinds.quote: Failure of at least 6 weeks of conservative non-operative management
Failure of at least 6 months of conservative non-operative management that included supervised physical therapy
MRI evidence of a frank (non-degenerative) meniscus tear
Xrays demonstrate absent or minimal osteoarthritis (Kellgren-Lawrence grade 0-2)
Osteoarthritis is classified as Outerbridge grade I or II
Individual is considered too young (e.g., age 54 or younger) to be an appropriate candidate for total knee arthroplasty
There are mechanical symptoms (including, but are not limited to, locking, snapping, or popping)
Limited range of motion, effusion, and/or painful weight bearing, present for at least 3 months
Post-surgical, post-trauma, or post-infection arthrofibrosis of the knee
Inadequate response to a prior surgical procedure (e.g., abrasion, microfracture, drilling)
No improvement in symptoms following a minimum of 6 months of DMARD therapy (if not contraindicated)
Allograft is non-collagen and harvested via a cadaver (either fresh viable, fresh frozen, cryopreserved, or lyophilized)
At least 3 months have passed since surgery, traumatic injury, or infection

thresholds.quote: at least 3 months of conservative non-operative management that includes at least 2 of the following
advanced arthritis (Kellgren grade III or IV)

thresholds.quantity: K-L grade (lateral release, medial PF OA)
thresholds.quote: Medial patellofemoral osteoarthritis is Kellgren-Lawrence grade 0 or 1
Osteoarthritis is classified as Outerbridge grade I or II
Absence of greater than 50% of the meniscus, established by imaging or prior surgery

time_windows.quote: Failure of at least 3 months of conservative non-operative management
Failure of at least 6 weeks of conservative non-operative management
Failure of at least 6 weeks of physical therapy
Failure of at least 6 months of conservative non-operative management
minimum of 6 months of DMARD therapy

time_windows.quote: At least 3 months have passed since surgery, traumatic injury, or infection

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: Listed in one flat table (27332-27428, 29866-29889, C8003, G0289) with no mapping to criteria blocks. 27412 (ACI) and 29871/29885-29887 are absent here although other payers list them; ACI is pushed to a related guideline.
codes.non_covered_code_lists: C8003 (MISHA) marked Investigational; MISHA 'for any indication' is experimental.

Grade II: Partial thickness defect, fissures < 1.5cm diameter/wide

vague_terms.quote: Xray and MRI results are inconclusive
vague_terms.problem: No definition of inconclusive; chart must contain a radiologist statement of that kind.

vague_terms.quote: MRI evidence of a tear considered repairable by the surgeon
vague_terms.problem: Defers to surgeon opinion; not a chart fact.

vague_terms.quote: Normal knee biomechanics or alignment and stability is present or will be achieved concurrently

vague_terms.problem: Example, not a rule; boundary is judgement.

vague_terms.quote: mechanical symptoms (including, but not limited to, locking, snapping, or popping)

vague_terms.problem: No minimum dose, frequency or visit count for PT; 'failure' not defined.

vague_terms.quote: limited ability to straighten the le.g., limping
vague_terms.problem: Typo-corrupted criterion ('leg' fused with 'e.g.'); symptoms any-of list unclear.

extraction_hazards: Two-column-looking bullets with three nested levels (bullet, o, dash) rendered as indentation only
A stray OR/AND at the end of a nested bullet carries scope
Page break splits Meniscectomy third bullet and the 'Failure of at least 6 weeks' sub-list is separated from its parent by a blank line
Grade tables at the end of the position statement, referenced by ** and *** footnote marks that pdftotext does not attach to the criteria
Typos: 'kneeing', 'le.g.,', 'the all of the following' (LAA doc)
Revision log lists criteria that existed earlier (e.g., 'Marx scale and Tegner score') which are no longer in the text; a naive reader may think they exist
Evidence summary is 230 lines of prose with numbers (e.g., '<2 cm2', 'Outerbridge') that look like criteria but are not
interesting_structures: Per-procedure blocks with different therapy durations (6 weeks / 3 months / 6 months)
Recurring k-of-n 'at least 2 of 6' conservative therapy menu, with one variant 'supervised PT plus at least 1 of the rest' (lateral release, realignment)
Alternative branches with one branch having no conservative-therapy requirement (pediatric meniscal tear)
Imaging negative findings required (no meniscal tear) for diagnostic arthroscopy: criteria that depend on the absence of a finding
Silent gaps: no coverage statement for ACI, collateral ligaments, MUA

fit_to_tree.why: Each block is clean all/any with a k-of-n leaf, but the procedure must be picked first (pathway selection), grade thresholds depend on tables elsewhere, and several leaves need surgeon judgement ('repairable', 'inconclusive', 'disabling').
